ready1_open_rewrite.title: GeoSQA open-ended question (daytime reason)
ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: Lima (the capital of Peru) is the world-famous “dry city”: there are no drainage ditches on the streets, houses also have no eaves, and department stores also have no rain gear for sale. But in one year, about half the year is a season of heavy fog. When the dense fog moves, it is like fine drizzling rain, and local people call this dense fog drizzle. Combine the map of Lima and the surrounding region, and answer the question. <image1> Compared with the climate zone where place B is located, the climate zone where place C is located has a larger diurnal temperature range. From the perspective of daytime, which effect of the atmosphere at place C is weaker?
ready1_open_rewrite.expected_answer: The atmospheric reflection effect during daytime is weak
